answer: Agents earn entry by proving they can meet a strict round-trip latency budget to a set of globally distributed beacon nodes whose positions are fixed to an immutable anchor of undersea cable endpoints; the protocol measures the minimum observed latency over a sliding window and rejects any identity whose median exceeds the glacier threshold, forcing a sybil operator to deploy physical hardware at each horizon point, a cost that scales linearly with the number of fake identities and dwarfs any software-only attack.
